blocks.html: Watch live IP-camera, Rover5 and H.264 video feeds in ATAK, grab a still, record clips, and push the feed onto the map.

slides.title: Open a video and play it
slides.html: Tap the Video Player icon to open the list of feeds. Select a video alias or file name to start playing.

slides.title: Use the playback controls
slides.html: The video shows at half-screen with play/pause, elapsed time and mute/unmute. Slide the pull bar to go full screen; press the device Back button to return.

slides.title: Snapshot a frame
slides.html: Tap the Snapshot icon to save the current frame as a JPEG; the icon flashes green when done. Tap the snapshots icon to open the Video Snapshots gallery.

slides.title: Send a snapshot
slides.html: Open a snapshot, then tap Send to push it to another TAK user, the TAK server, or a 3rd party app. Use Arrow to cycle to the next snapshot.

slides.title: Record the feed to a file
slides.html: For a live UDP or RTSP stream, tap Record to start; it turns into a green square while recording. Tap Record again to stop. Clips save to /atak/tools/videos/.

slides.title: Show the feed on the map
slides.html: If the stream carries corner metadata, tap the Globe icon in the top-right of the video window. The globe turns green and the feed overlays directly on the map.
